description.value: The Comox Valley Aquatic Centre is a publicly operated indoor swimming facility run by the Comox Valley Regional District, serving residents and visitors across the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. As a regional aquatic facility, it likely offers amenities typical of public swim centres — pool access, change rooms, and showers — making it a potential rest stop for touring cyclists seeking a swim or rinse-off. It sits on Lerwick Road in the Courtenay area, within easy reach of popular cycling routes on the Island.
